subject.title: [Bug] Subagent prompt prefix truncation error when tool definitions exceed context limit

question: Should OpenClaw introduce adaptive subagent tool-schema shedding and a prompt-budget warning once a reproducible current-main failure demonstrates that existing context management cannot preserve the required instructions?
rationale: The report proposes a new selection policy and warning threshold, but does not yet show that current behavior is broken or that tool schemas are the correct component to shed.

options.title: Request a focused reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue open pending a current-version example with the model limit, enabled tools, expected prompt, actual truncation, and diagnostic output.

options.title: Sponsor prompt-budget policy work
options.body: Confirm that adaptive tool selection is desired, then define the selection invariant and provider coverage before implementation.

options.title: Close as unsupported diagnosis
options.body: Close only if source inspection confirms the alleged truncation path does not exist and no reproducible report is supplied.

recommendation.title: Request a focused reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open pending a current-version example with the model limit, enabled tools, expected prompt, actual truncation, and diagnostic output.

likelyOwner.reason: A repo-level decision is needed because the requested behavior changes agent capability and prompt-budget policy rather than a proven local defect.
